page.layout: One printed page: running title at top centre; below it a table of contents in two blocks. First block: a list of numbered theses with page references at right, the group bracketed by "De" at left. Then a centred heading "LOCUS XXIV." and a large centred heading "DE CONSTANTIA FOEDERIS GRATIAE" in two lines. Second block: a numbered list with references at right ("Thef." column heading at top right), the group bracketed by "De". Ends with a row of ornaments and a catchword "LO-" at lower right.
